description: Sends a new message. Needs the agent to be allowed to send to anyone; in reply-only mode use reply instead.

attachments.description: Paths of files to attach, inside the agent's files folder only (by default ~/.config/mailcycle/files, or the folders set in MAILCYCLE_FILES_DIR). Up to 10, 3.5 MB between them. Files outside that folder, symbolic links, and program or script files are refused.

from.description: One of this agent's addresses. Can be left out if it has only one.

name: send_message
title: Send a message
